title: Create order and New ticket on the profile
problem: Staff on a customer's page could not start an order or a support ticket for that customer.
now: The profile's More menu and Overview have Create order and New ticket; the ticket form opens with the name and phone filled in.
steps: Tap More › New ticket and check the name and phone
Make the ticket and see it on the customer's Overview
Tap Create order: the order form opens with the customer picked
notes: Where: Customers › All customers › a customer (/customer-crm)

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const b = document.querySelector('.mn-x'); if (!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } })()
